title: The Art Institute in Chicago Highlights Tour & Photoshoot
includes: Photoshoot - Get ARTISTIC PHOTOS for your Instagram/Portraits
Museum Entrance - Admission to the museum included
Knowledge - Solid overview of this world class museum
Storytelling - Know the history and stories of artwork and artists
Guidance - You will see 7 out of the 12 highlights of the museum
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the Art Institute in a unique way that blends art, storytelling, and photography. After a warm welcome, we'll head inside with tickets included & begin an immersive journey through the galleries.
Together, we'll explore the museum's most celebrated highlights, featuring masterpieces by Monet, Picasso, Van Gogh, Dalí, Warhol, Hopper, and more. I'll share fascinating stories that bring the art and its creators to life, revealing the hidden meanings and personal histories behind.
Along the way, I'll capture beautiful, candid photographs at the best photo spots. Using your phone or my iPhone 14 Pro, I'll guide you with simple posing tips and angles to ensure you receive stunning, professional-quality images perfect for memories or social media.
Anyone looking for more than just a museum visit, you'll leave with gallery-worthy images plus knowledge that transforms how you experience art—an unforgettable blend of photography, storytelling, & culture.
Looking forward to hosting you!
